changelog.body:
🇬🇧 English
- New add-on: Cloud Profiles (requires Premium). Back up the profiles you choose (or all of them) to the cloud and restore them on another phone signed in to your account. Backups are encrypted on your phone with your own password before they are uploaded, and each cloud backup is kept for up to 30 days. A forgotten password cannot be recovered. Open it from Settings → Cloud Profiles.
- When restoring, choose which profiles to bring back. The other profiles on your phone are left untouched unless you turn on "Replace all existing profiles".
- Other improvements and bug fixes.
- Please restart your device after updating.

🇨🇳 简体中文
- 新增附加功能：Cloud Profiles（需要 Premium）。将你选择的配置文件（或全部）备份到云端，并在登录同一账户的另一部手机上恢复。备份在上传前会在你的手机上用你自己的密码加密，每个云备份最多保留 30 天。忘记密码将无法找回。可在 设置 → Cloud Profiles 中打开。
- 恢复时可选择要恢复哪些配置文件。除非开启"替换所有现有配置文件"，手机上的其他配置文件都会保持不变。
- 其他改进与错误修复。
- 更新后请重启设备。

🇷🇺 Русский
- Новое дополнение: Cloud Profiles (требуется Premium). Сохраняйте выбранные профили (или все сразу) в облаке и восстанавливайте их на другом телефоне, где выполнен вход в ваш аккаунт. Перед загрузкой резервные копии шифруются на вашем телефоне вашим собственным паролем, а каждая облачная копия хранится до 30 дней. Забытый пароль восстановить невозможно. Откройте через Настройки → Cloud Profiles.
- При восстановлении выберите, какие профили вернуть. Остальные профили на телефоне остаются нетронутыми, если не включить «Заменить все существующие профили».
- Прочие улучшения и исправления.
- После обновления перезагрузите устройство.

🇮🇩 Bahasa Indonesia
- Add-on baru: Cloud Profiles (memerlukan Premium). Cadangkan profil yang Anda pilih (atau semuanya) ke cloud, lalu pulihkan di ponsel lain yang masuk ke akun Anda. Cadangan dienkripsi di ponsel Anda dengan kata sandi Anda sendiri sebelum diunggah, dan setiap cadangan cloud disimpan hingga 30 hari. Kata sandi yang terlupa tidak dapat dipulihkan. Buka dari Pengaturan → Cloud Profiles.
- Saat memulihkan, pilih profil mana yang ingin dikembalikan. Profil lain di ponsel Anda tetap utuh kecuali Anda mengaktifkan "Ganti semua profil yang ada".
- Peningkatan lain dan perbaikan bug.
- Mohon mulai ulang perangkat setelah memperbarui.

🇮🇳 Hindi
- Naya addon: Cloud Profiles (Premium zaroori). Apne chune hue profiles (ya sabhi) ka cloud par backup lein aur unhe apne account se signed-in kisi doosre phone par restore karein. Upload se pehle backup aapke phone par aapke apne password se encrypt hota hai, aur har cloud backup 30 din tak rakha jaata hai. Bhoola hua password recover nahin kiya ja sakta. Ise Settings → Cloud Profiles se kholein.
- Restore karte samay chunein ki kaun se profiles wapas laane hain. Aapke phone ke baaki profiles waise hi rehte hain, jab tak aap "Maujooda sabhi profiles badlein" chalu nahin karte.
- Anya sudhaar aur bug fixes.
- Update ke baad apna device restart karein.

🇫🇷 Français
- Nouveau module : Cloud Profiles (Premium requis). Sauvegardez dans le cloud les profils de votre choix (ou tous) et restaurez-les sur un autre téléphone connecté à votre compte. Les sauvegardes sont chiffrées sur votre téléphone avec votre propre mot de passe avant l'envoi, et chaque sauvegarde cloud est conservée jusqu'à 30 jours. Un mot de passe oublié ne peut pas être récupéré. Ouvrez-le depuis Paramètres → Cloud Profiles.
- Lors de la restauration, choisissez les profils à récupérer. Les autres profils de votre téléphone restent intacts, sauf si vous activez « Remplacer tous les profils existants ».
- Autres améliorations et corrections de bugs.
- Veuillez redémarrer votre appareil après la mise à jour.

🇬🇧 English
- New: Auto backup & restore for each profile. Turn it on for a profile and HideMyAndroid backs up that profile's apps when you switch away from it (or deactivate it) and restores them when you switch back, so you no longer need to back up by hand between profiles. Turn it on in New/Edit Profile or from the profile's ⋮ menu.
- A profile switch keeps running in the background and shows its progress. If a backup fails, you are asked before anything is cleared.
- Other improvements and bug fixes.
- Please restart your device after updating.

🇨🇳 简体中文
- 新增：按配置文件自动备份与恢复。为某个配置文件开启后，当你切换离开（或停用）该配置文件时，HideMyAndroid 会备份其应用，切换回来时再自动恢复，无需再在配置文件之间手动备份。可在新建/编辑配置文件或配置文件的 ⋮ 菜单中开启。
- 切换配置文件会在后台继续进行并显示进度。如果备份失败，会在清除任何数据之前先询问你。
- 其他改进与错误修复。
- 更新后请重启设备。

🇷🇺 Русский
- Новое: автобэкап и восстановление для каждого профиля. Включите функцию для профиля, и HideMyAndroid будет создавать резервную копию его приложений, когда вы переключаетесь на другой профиль (или деактивируете его), и восстанавливать их при возврате — больше не нужно вручную делать бэкапы между профилями. Включается в окне создания/редактирования профиля или в меню ⋮ профиля.
- Переключение профиля продолжается в фоне и показывает прогресс. Если резервное копирование не удалось, приложение спросит вас, прежде чем что-либо очистить.
- Прочие улучшения и исправления.
- После обновления перезагрузите устройство.

🇮🇩 Bahasa Indonesia
- Baru: cadangan & pemulihan otomatis untuk setiap profil. Aktifkan untuk sebuah profil, dan HideMyAndroid akan mencadangkan aplikasi profil itu saat Anda beralih darinya (atau menonaktifkannya) lalu memulihkannya saat Anda kembali, sehingga Anda tidak perlu lagi mencadangkan secara manual antarprofil. Aktifkan di Buat/Edit Profil atau dari menu ⋮ profil.
- Peralihan profil tetap berjalan di latar belakang dan menampilkan progresnya. Jika pencadangan gagal, Anda akan ditanya sebelum ada data yang dihapus.
- Peningkatan lain dan perbaikan bug.
- Mohon mulai ulang perangkat setelah memperbarui.

🇮🇳 Hindi
- Naya: har profile ke liye auto backup aur restore. Kisi profile ke liye ise chalu karein, aur jab aap us profile se switch karenge (ya use deactivate karenge) to HideMyAndroid uske apps ka backup lega, aur wapas aane par unhein restore kar dega, isliye ab profiles ke beech haath se backup lene ki zarurat nahi. Ise New/Edit Profile mein ya profile ke ⋮ menu se chalu karein.
- Profile switch background mein chalta rehta hai aur progress dikhata hai. Agar backup fail ho jaaye to kuch bhi clear karne se pehle aapse poocha jaata hai.
- Anya sudhaar aur bug fixes.
- Update ke baad apna device restart karein.

🇫🇷 Français
- Nouveau : sauvegarde et restauration automatiques pour chaque profil. Activez-les pour un profil et HideMyAndroid sauvegarde ses applications quand vous passez à un autre profil (ou le désactivez), puis les restaure quand vous y revenez : plus besoin de sauvegarder à la main entre deux profils. À activer dans Nouveau/Modifier le profil ou depuis le menu ⋮ du profil.
- Le changement de profil continue en arrière-plan et affiche sa progression. Si une sauvegarde échoue, l'application vous demande avant d'effacer quoi que ce soit.
- Autres améliorations et corrections de bugs.
- Veuillez redémarrer votre appareil après la mise à jour.

🇬🇧 English
- New: Zygisk engine. HideMyAndroid now includes a companion Zygisk module that applies your disguise deeper in the system, so it stays consistent across apps and is much harder to detect.
- New: Saved proxies. Save a proxy once and reuse it across profiles; editing a saved proxy updates every profile that uses it.
- Stronger emulator hiding and better resistance to detection.
- Virtual SIM improvements, including a search box when choosing the SIM country.
- Other improvements and bug fixes.
- Please restart your device after updating.

🇨🇳 简体中文
- 新增：Zygisk 引擎。HideMyAndroid 现在附带配套的 Zygisk 模块，可在系统更底层应用你的伪装，使其在各应用之间保持一致，更难被检测。
- 新增：已保存代理。保存一次代理即可在多个配置中重复使用；修改已保存的代理会同步更新所有使用它的配置。
- 更强的模拟器隐藏，更好地应对各类检测。
- 虚拟 SIM 改进，新增选择 SIM 国家/地区时的搜索框。
- 其他改进与错误修复。
- 更新后请重启设备。

🇷🇺 Русский
- Новое: движок Zygisk. HideMyAndroid теперь поставляется с сопутствующим модулем Zygisk, который применяет вашу маскировку на более глубоком уровне системы, поэтому она согласована между приложениями и её гораздо труднее обнаружить.
- Новое: сохранённые прокси. Сохраните прокси один раз и используйте его в разных профилях; изменение сохранённого прокси обновляет все профили, где он применяется.
- Более надёжное сокрытие эмулятора и лучшее сопротивление обнаружению.
- Улучшения виртуальной SIM, включая поле поиска при выборе страны SIM.
- Прочие улучшения и исправления.
- После обновления перезагрузите устройство.

🇮🇩 Bahasa Indonesia
- Baru: mesin Zygisk. HideMyAndroid kini menyertakan modul Zygisk pendamping yang menerapkan penyamaran Anda lebih dalam di sistem, sehingga tetap konsisten antaraplikasi dan jauh lebih sulit dideteksi.
- Baru: proxy tersimpan. Simpan proxy sekali dan gunakan kembali di berbagai profil; mengubah proxy tersimpan akan memperbarui semua profil yang memakainya.
- Penyembunyian emulator lebih kuat dan lebih tahan terhadap deteksi.
- Peningkatan SIM virtual, termasuk kotak pencarian saat memilih negara SIM.
- Peningkatan lain dan perbaikan bug.
- Mohon mulai ulang perangkat setelah memperbarui.

🇮🇳 Hindi
- Naya: Zygisk engine. HideMyAndroid ab ek companion Zygisk module ke saath aata hai jo aapki disguise ko system mein aur gehraai se lagaata hai, isliye yeh apps ke beech consistent rehti hai aur detect karna kaafi mushkil ho jaata hai.
- Naya: saved proxies. Ek baar proxy save karein aur alag-alag profiles mein dobara istemaal karein; saved proxy badalne par usse use karne wale sabhi profiles update ho jaate hain.
- Behtar emulator hiding aur detection ke khilaaf zyada suraksha.
- Virtual SIM mein sudhaar, including SIM country chunte samay ek search box.
- Anya sudhaar aur bug fixes.
- Update ke baad apna device restart karein.

🇫🇷 Français
- Nouveau : moteur Zygisk. HideMyAndroid intègre désormais un module Zygisk compagnon qui applique votre déguisement plus en profondeur dans le système, de sorte qu'il reste cohérent entre les applications et bien plus difficile à détecter.
- Nouveau : proxys enregistrés. Enregistrez un proxy une fois et réutilisez-le dans plusieurs profils ; modifier un proxy enregistré met à jour tous les profils qui l'utilisent.
- Masquage d'émulateur renforcé et meilleure résistance à la détection.
- Améliorations de la SIM virtuelle, dont un champ de recherche pour choisir le pays de la SIM.
- Autres améliorations et corrections de bugs.
- Veuillez redémarrer votre appareil après la mise à jour.

🇬🇧 English
- New: HideMyAndroid now works together with HideMyEmulator — combine the two so apps running on an emulator see a consistent real-device profile, making emulator detection much harder.
- Other improvements and bug fixes.
- Please restart your device after updating.

🇨🇳 简体中文
- 新增：HideMyAndroid 现在可与 HideMyEmulator 配合使用 — 两者结合后，在模拟器中运行的应用会看到一致的真实设备信息，大幅降低被识别为模拟器的几率。
- 其他改进与错误修复。
- 更新后请重启设备。

🇷🇺 Русский
- Новое: HideMyAndroid теперь работает вместе с HideMyEmulator — используйте их совместно, и приложения в эмуляторе будут видеть согласованный профиль реального устройства, из-за чего обнаружить эмулятор гораздо сложнее.
- Прочие улучшения и исправления.
- После обновления перезагрузите устройство.

🇮🇩 Bahasa Indonesia
- Baru: HideMyAndroid kini dapat dipadukan dengan HideMyEmulator — gunakan keduanya bersama agar aplikasi yang berjalan di emulator melihat profil perangkat nyata yang konsisten, sehingga deteksi emulator jauh lebih sulit.
- Peningkatan lain dan perbaikan bug.
- Mohon mulai ulang perangkat setelah memperbarui.

🇮🇳 Hindi
- Naya: HideMyAndroid ab HideMyEmulator ke saath kaam karta hai — dono ko saath istemaal karein taaki emulator par chal rahe apps ek consistent asli-device profile dekhein, jisse emulator detection bahut mushkil ho jaata hai.
- Anya sudhaar aur bug fixes.
- Update ke baad apna device restart karein.

🇫🇷 Français
- Nouveau : HideMyAndroid fonctionne désormais avec HideMyEmulator — combinez les deux pour que les applications sur un émulateur voient un profil cohérent d'appareil réel, ce qui rend la détection d'émulateur bien plus difficile.
- Autres améliorations et corrections de bugs.
- Veuillez redémarrer votre appareil après la mise à jour.

🇬🇧 English
- Fixed an issue where your Premium license could be lost (shown as Free) after a server security certificate update.

🇨🇳 简体中文
- 修复了服务器安全证书更新后可能导致高级版授权丢失（显示为免费版）的问题。

🇷🇺 Русский
- Исправлена ошибка, из-за которой лицензия Premium могла сбрасываться (отображалась как Free) после обновления сертификата безопасности сервера.

🇮🇩 Bahasa Indonesia
- Memperbaiki masalah yang menyebabkan lisensi Premium bisa hilang (ditampilkan sebagai Free) setelah pembaruan sertifikat keamanan server.

🇮🇳 Hindi (Latin)
- Server security certificate update ke baad Premium license kho jaane (Free dikhne) wali problem ko theek kiya.

🇫🇷 Français
- Correction d'un problème pouvant entraîner la perte de la licence Premium (affichée comme Free) après une mise à jour du certificat de sécurité du serveur.

🇬🇧 English
* Improved app identity and license protection.
* Overall performance and stability improvements.
* Fixed several minor bugs.
* Please restart your device after updating.

🇨🇳 简体中文
* 改进了应用身份与授权保护。
* 整体性能与稳定性提升。
* 修复了若干小问题。
* 更新后请重启设备。

🇷🇺 Русский
* Улучшена защита идентификации приложения и лицензии.
* Общие улучшения производительности и стабильности.
* Исправлены некоторые мелкие ошибки.
* После обновления перезагрузите устройство.

🇮🇩 Bahasa Indonesia
* Meningkatkan perlindungan identitas dan lisensi aplikasi.
* Peningkatan performa dan stabilitas secara keseluruhan.
* Memperbaiki beberapa bug kecil.
* Harap mulai ulang perangkat setelah memperbarui.

🇮🇳 Hindi (Latin)
* App pehchaan aur license suraksha ko behtar banaya gaya.
* Overall performance aur stability mein sudhaar.
* Kuch chhoti bugs theek ki gayin.
* Update ke baad kripya apne device ko restart karein.

🇫🇷 Français
* Amélioration de la protection de l'identité et de la licence de l'application.
* Améliorations générales des performances et de la stabilité.
* Correction de plusieurs bugs mineurs.
* Veuillez redémarrer votre appareil après la mise à jour.

- New Addons tab (replaces Tools): browse, search addons right in the app, and turn each owned addon on or off
- The virtual SIM now follows your proxy country: switching to a proxy in another country regenerates the SIM to match
- Fixed the real country leaking on devices without a SIM card
- The virtual SIM now reports a "ready" state like a real SIM

- Sensor spoofing now also covers apps that read sensors through native code (NDK)
- Native and Java sensor readings now return identical values, so apps can no longer tell them apart
- Fixed proximity sensor values not being spoofed in some apps
- Fixed a rare mismatch in light sensor values between different readers

- Added French language support
- Fixed text overflow and layout issues in several languages
- Long update notes now scroll so the install button always stays reachable
- Improved the update card, app filters and Premium comparison table layout
- More screens are now fully translated
- Fix some crash issues on Android 16

- Realistic sensors, fully upgraded: all motion sensors now come from one simulated phone held in a hand. The accelerometer, gyroscope, gravity, linear acceleration, rotation vector and orientation all describe the same movement, so apps that check one sensor against another get consistent results.
- New: magnetometer (compass) spoofing. The magnetic field matches your profile's spoofed location, and the compass direction agrees with the other motion sensors.
- New: barometer (pressure) spoofing. Air pressure matches the altitude your spoofed GPS location reports, with small natural weather changes.
- Smarter light sensor: light levels now follow the time of day in your profile's timezone (night, twilight, day). They also dim when the proximity sensor is covered, like a phone held to your ear.
- New: sensor list matches the simulated device. When Device Simulation is on, the sensor names, vendors and specs that apps can read match the phone model you picked. Sensors that model wouldn't have are hidden.
- Each profile now keeps its own stable sensor calibration values, so a profile looks like the same physical phone across app restarts and across all its target apps.
- Improved install-time protection: the app install date that apps read from files on disk now matches your profile's spoofed install date.
- Improved root & hook hiding: covered more debugger and hook checks, hid more traces of systemless root modifications, and hid the "OEM unlocking" developer flag.
- New toggles for each new sensor are in the profile's Privacy Settings. They are on by default for existing profiles.
- Various stability improvements and minor bug fixes.

- Improved VPN hiding: some apps could still detect an active VPN through an older Android network API — that gap is now closed.
- Strengthened protection of your identity
- Various stability improvements and minor bug fixes.

- Fixed a Google Advertising ID (GAID) leak — some apps could still read your real advertising ID by asking the ad service directly over its binder interface, bypassing the spoof. That path is now covered, so your profile's advertising ID stays consistent everywhere.
- Improved stability on Android 16

- Improved device identity protection: closed a few more ways apps could read your real device ID and system settings, so spoofed profiles stay consistent.
- Improved root hiding: better filtering of root and system traces from apps that inspect system command output.
- Fixed a sign-in issue where an expired session could get stuck instead of automatically refreshing or signing you out.
- Fixed several important bugs and general stability improvements.

- Added realistic light (ambient) sensor spoofing — the reported light level now follows a natural, continuously changing pattern that you can match to a setting (indoor, on the move, outdoors, or night), so apps see believable sensor data instead of a static or missing value.
- Fix some mirror bugs

- Added realistic gyroscope motion spoofing, synchronized with the accelerometer so both sensors report consistent, believable movement — including the raw (uncalibrated) values some apps cross-check.
- Delete profile now asks for confirmation before removing anything, and Delete has been moved away from "Set as active" in the profile menu to prevent accidental deletion.

- Hide the module's own footprint from apps that scan the process memory maps, so it is no longer visible to them.
- Hide root and root-manager traces from apps that read the process mount list, making a spoofed device less likely to be flagged as rooted or hooked.
- Fixed a few minor issues from the previous version

- Added spoofing of extra advertising identifiers (OAID) to reduce tracking on supported devices
- Stability and compatibility improvements
- Fix crashes on some devices

- Fix some payment issues
- Make the app's installation source more trustworthy

- Improve the system
- Improve the user interface
- Fix some minor bugs
- Fix license loss issues

- Fixed several issues from the previous version.
- Updates are no longer mandatory by default.
- Mandatory updates will only be required for certain critical versions.

- Added a headless backup and restore API to automate profile backups without opening the app
- Improved device simulation to better match real devices
- Improved hiding of root access from detection
- Fixed profile backup folders not being fully removed when deleted

- Fix app crashes on certain devices
- Improve the hidden Developer Options feature
- Improve the user interface (UI)

- Added Google Play Billing support
- Fixed license issues on some devices
- Improved UI/UX
- Fixed some issues from the previous version
- Fixed several issues related to application crashes
- Fixed some issues from the previous version

Official Website: https://www.hidemyandroid.com Web App / Dashboard: https://app.hidemyandroid.com How to install: https://www.hidemyandroid.com/en/how-to-install/ ### Requirements - Android 9.0+ (Pie or newer) - Rooted Android device - Properly working Xposed/LSPosed environment - If you are not familiar with Xposed modules, this project may not be suitable for your setup. ### How It Works When a target app requests identifiers or environment signals, HideMyAndroid intercepts the request and returns configured spoofed values based on your selected profile. ### Feature List - Spoof Device Identifiers (Android ID, GAID, GSF ID, Widevine DRM ID, App Set ID, IMEI, Serial, ...) - Native-Level Protection: spoofed values apply to Java APIs and to native (C/C++) code paths, so apps that read system properties, files or sensors natively see the same values - Spoof SIM Card Info - Spoof Mobile Number - Hide Root - Hide LSPosed - Hide VPN Connection - Hide Active Proxy Connection from Apps - Browser Fingerprint - Hide Airplane Mode - Hide Wi-Fi Information (NAME/MAC) - Spoof Nearby Wi-Fi Networks - Spoof Nearby Bluetooth Devices - Block LAN Scan - Hide Developer Mode - Headless Mode (Developer Mode) - Spoof Play Store Installation - Spoof Timezone Based on IP - Spoof Region Based on IP - Spoof GPS Location Based on IP - Spoof App Identity - Isolated Account Environment - Virtual Gmail Accounts Per Profile - Hide Installed Applications - Realistic Sensor Data: accelerometer, gyroscope, compass and motion fusion sensors all come from one simulated motion model, while the compass, barometer and light sensor follow the profile's location, altitude and local time, so cross-checks between sensors stay consistent. - Magnetometer: simulate a compass field matching the profile location and device orientation. - Motion fusion sensors: keep gravity, linear acceleration, rotation vector and orientation consistent with the simulated motion. - Barometer: report air pressure that matches the spoofed location's altitude, with slow weather drift. - Sensor list: make the sensor list and each sensor's name, vendor, range and resolution match the simulated device. - Spoof Device Uptime - Device Simulation - Hide My Emulator (add-on): running HideMyAndroid on an Android emulator? Target apps see a real phone instead - Profile-Based System - Backup & Restore app's data - Cloud Profiles (Premium add-on): move profiles between phones. Back up any or all profiles with their app data, encrypted on your phone with your own password before upload, then restore them on your other phones - Per-Profile Proxy (each profile can use its own independent proxy configuration) - Hide Suspicious Keyboards - Virtual Default Keyboard Value - Many More Features ### Free vs Premium | Features | Freemium | Premium (Subscription) | |
